display.title: Episode 481: The Two Brothers
display.summary_short: Why Hashem chose Har HaMoriah for the Beis HaMikdash: the story of two brothers who each secretly carried wheat to the other at midnight and met on the mountaintop.
display.summary_long: Broadcast a week and a half after Shavuos. Uncle Yossi explains how Tzivos Hashem soldiers earn points and rise in rank by completing mitzvah missions from the newsletter. After the Hakochainik march, a seven-year-old girl from a Bronx girls' school, joined by her proud parents, says the Shema, and everyone gives tzedakah. With Matan Torah still fresh, Uncle Yossi teaches that Hashem wants a neshamah in a body, and that after the Torah was given He told the Jewish people to build a Mishkan, later the Beis HaMikdash, where His presence would rest. Then comes the story of why Hashem chose Har HaMoriah: two brother farmers, one with a large family and one with none, each decide to carry wheat secretly to the other's field at midnight. Climbing the mountain, they meet at the top and embrace in tears of joy, and Hashem chooses that spot for His house. The show ends with advice on choosing a kosher, Shabbos-observant summer camp and the Shabbos candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: We are all children of Hashem, so we should love and help one another like brothers and sisters; this brings Hashem joy and brings the Geulah closer.
